description:
WallPair lets you connect with one trusted partner and privately share meaningful photos and wallpapers with each other.

Free users can send up to 3 wallpapers in total. WallPair Premium unlocks unlimited wallpaper sharing while your subscription is active.

Connect using a WallPair ID, QR code, or invite link. Once connected, you can select a photo and send it through your private partner connection.

On iPhone, received images can be reviewed and saved to Photos so they can be applied manually as wallpaper using iOS.

WallPair is designed for private, one-to-one connections. There are no public profiles, random matches, public feeds, or messaging rooms.

KEY FEATURES

• Connect with one trusted partner using an ID, QR code, or invite link
• Send up to 3 wallpapers for free
• Unlock unlimited wallpaper sharing with WallPair Premium
• Send photos through a private partner connection
• Save received photos to the Photos app on iPhone
• Review and approve incoming wallpaper requests
• Allow trusted partners to send without an additional approval step
• Disconnect, remove, report, block, or unblock users
• Receive notifications for connection requests and wallpaper activity
• Delete your WallPair account from the app
• Optional Monthly and Annual Premium subscriptions

PRIVACY AND CONTROL

Your photos are shared only through your selected partner connection. WallPair does not provide public discovery, public profiles, random user matching, or public messaging.

You control your partner connection, wallpaper approval preferences, notification permissions, and account deletion options.

SUBSCRIPTIONS

WallPair includes 3 lifetime wallpaper sends for free.

WallPair offers optional auto-renewable Monthly Premium and Annual Premium subscriptions. Premium provides unlimited wallpaper sharing while the subscription is active.

Payment will be charged to your App Store account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your App Store account settings.

Deleting your WallPair account does not automatically cancel an active App Store subscription.
